meta.name: SD Fit Sizing & Style Knowledge Pack
meta.warning: All size bands in this pack are illustrative starter estimates, not universal or certified sizing standards. Actual sizes vary by brand, garment, fabric, cut and country. Use product-specific charts for accurate recommendations.

measurement_instructions.height_cm: Measure from floor to top of head without shoes.
measurement_instructions.chest_cm: Wrap tape horizontally around the fullest chest, keeping it level and comfortably snug.
measurement_instructions.bust_cm: Wrap tape horizontally around the fullest bust, keeping it level and comfortably snug.
measurement_instructions.waist_cm: Measure at the natural waist or the point specified by the brand chart; do not pull tight.
measurement_instructions.hips_cm: Measure around the fullest part of hips/seat.
measurement_instructions.shoulder_cm: Measure across the back from shoulder point to shoulder point.
measurement_instructions.inseam_cm: Measure from crotch seam to trouser hem, or compare with well-fitting trousers.
measurement_instructions.sleeve_cm: Measure from shoulder point to wrist with arm slightly bent.
measurement_instructions.foot_length_cm: Stand on paper, mark heel and longest toe, then measure. Use the brand's shoe chart.

boys.label: Rectangle
boys.cues: Chest, waist and hips relatively similar.
ideas: Structured overshirts or jackets for added shape if desired
Straight or gently tapered trousers
Texture and colour-blocking for visual structure
fit: Choose size from garment chart, not shape

boys.label: Inverted triangle
ideas: Simple shoulder lines and open collars
Straight or relaxed trousers to balance proportions if desired
V-necks or vertical details
fit: Buttons should not pull across chest

boys.label: Triangle
ideas: Structured upper layers if desired
Simple bottoms with textured tops
Straight-leg trousers
fit: Do not size down if the waistband or hips pull

boys.label: Oval
boys.cues: Midsection fuller relative to shoulders and hips.
ideas: Softly structured layers and draping fabrics
Open overshirts or vertical seams if preferred
Mid-rise straight or relaxed trousers
fit: Prioritize comfort when sitting and moving

boys.label: Trapezoid
boys.cues: Shoulders somewhat broader than waist; proportions fairly balanced.
ideas: Try slim, regular or relaxed cuts
Tees, shirts, denim and layers are versatile
Experiment with colours and accessories
fit: Use chest/waist chart and personal preference

boys.label: Athletic / muscular
boys.cues: More developed shoulders, chest, arms or thighs; proportions vary.
ideas: Athletic cuts or stretch panels for movement
Try tapered or relaxed cuts
Check upper-arm and thigh room
fit: Do not size down to reduce looseness elsewhere
Consider tailoring if measurements span sizes

girls.label: Rectangle
girls.cues: Bust, waist and hips relatively similar.
ideas: Layering, belted pieces or texture if you like waist definition
Straight trousers, A-line skirts, structured jackets
Choose prints and colours by preference
fit: Fit bust/shoulders and hips first; tailoring can adjust waist

girls.label: Hourglass
girls.cues: Bust and hips relatively balanced with a more defined waist.
ideas: Wrap tops or shaped jackets if you like waist definition
Stretch or contoured cuts
Straight, wide-leg and A-line bottoms can all work
fit: Check both bust and hip measurements

girls.label: Pear
ideas: Detailed or structured tops if desired
Straight, bootcut or wide-leg bottoms
A-line skirts and dresses
fit: Prioritize hip/thigh room and a comfortable waistband

girls.label: Apple / midsection-forward
girls.cues: Midsection fuller relative to bust/hips; bodies vary widely.
ideas: Relaxed drape or open layers if preferred
Straight-leg bottoms
Choose fabric for comfort, not concealment

girls.label: Inverted triangle
girls.cues: Shoulders or bust broader than hips.
ideas: Simple shoulder lines with A-line or wide-leg bottoms if desired
V-necks or open collars
Use colour and print wherever you prefer
fit: Check shoulder seams, bust ease and arm movement

girls.label: Athletic / straight
girls.cues: May have straighter lines or more developed shoulders/legs.
ideas: Sporty layers, relaxed tailoring or wrap details
Stretch fabrics for movement
Fitted and loose silhouettes can both work
fit: Ensure comfortable movement across shoulders, bust, hips and thighs

fit_preferences.slim: Closer to the body, but without pulling, restricted movement or distorted seams.
fit_preferences.relaxed: Extra room through the garment; check length and shoulder drop.
fit_preferences.oversized: Intentionally loose; choose a designed oversized cut or compare garment measurements.

recommendation_rules: Use the selected product's brand-specific size chart first.
Compare every relevant measurement, not only chest/bust.
If measurements point to different sizes, explain the conflict and recommend checking garment cut, stretch and return policy.
Use body shape only for optional style ideas; never infer a precise size from body shape alone.
Use fit preference as a secondary choice only after checking the brand chart.
If measurements are missing or outside the chart, ask for remeasurement or return 'no reliable match'.
